evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract frames receipt-return as a stability-and-reliability good (conservation) while the seconds-timed receipt appeals to craft-quality mastery (competence).
The no-loss framing appeals to security and preservation of what works — conservation as the appealed-to good.
